caption: The drawing depicts the head and part of the wing of a bird, rendered in shades of brown, yellow, and orange. The bird's head is oriented to the right, with a pronounced, hooked beak that is yellow with a red interior and dark-lined mouth. The eye is large, rounded, and detailed with a dark pupil and a highlight. The head and visible parts of the wing and neck are covered in detailed, overlapping feathers, each outlined in darker brown and highlighted with lighter hues. The feathers are more densely drawn on the head and neck, fanning out and overlapping onto the upper portion of the wing, which extends to the left and is attached to a beige section representing part of the background or a support structure. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with the bird's form centrally positioned on the page. There are no additional objects or features present in the composition.
title: Eagle Woodcarving
